Microbiology (1996), 142,3469-3477                                                                                                                                                                           Printed in Great Britain




                                                                                    Lactobacillus curvatus has a glucose transport
                                                                                    system homologous to the mannose family of
                                                                                    phosphoenolpyruvate-dependent
                                                                                    phosphotransferase systems
                                                                                    Ana Veyrat, Maria Jose Gosalbes and Gaspar P&ez-Martinez

                                                                                    Author for correspondence : Gaspar Pkrez-Martinez. Tel :                                    +34 6 3900022. Fax: + 34 6 3636301.
                                                                                    e-mail : lactic@iata.csic.es


Departamento de                                                                     In Lactobacillus curvatus, a phosphoenolpyruvate:mannose
Biotecnologla, lnstituto de                                                         phosphotransferase system (mannose-PTS) has been characterizedand it was
Agroqulmica y Tecnologla
de Alimentos (CSIC),                                                                shown to be involved in glucose and mannose transport, but no glucose-
Pollgono de la Coma dn,                                                             specific PTS activity could be detected. A 2.1 kb DNA fragment amplified by
Apartado de Correos 73,                                                             PCR from the L. curvatus genome was sequenced. Sequence analysis showed
Burjasot, 46100 Valencia,
Spain                                                                               four ORFs which could encode proteins similar to PTS transporters EIIA, EIIB,
                                                                                    EllC and EllD of the mannose class. The expression of the manB gene (encoding
                                                                                    EIIB) from L. curvatus in a mutant of Lactobacilhs sake impaired in EllMan
                                                                                    activity restored this activity. Furthermore, this DNA fragment complemented
                                                                                    the regulatory function of LevE (EIIB) in a Bacillus subtilis lev€-deficient
                                                                                    mutant, suggesting that the protein encoded by manB could also play a
                                                                                    regulatory role in L. curvatus.

                                                                                                                                                                                 L. curvatus glucose transport system


                                                                                                                                                         the operon has been proposed (Martin e t al., 1990). The
                                                                                                                                                         product of the levR gene would undergo a
                                                                                                                                                         phosphorylation by EIILeV,being inactivated in this form
                                                                                                                                                         when fructose in the medium is limited. In fact, proteins
                                                                                                                                                         LevD and LevE (EIIALev and EIIBLeV) would be
                                                                                                                                                         involved in this regulation, since the expression of the
                                                                                                                                                         levanase operon becomes constitutive in mutants deficient
                                                                                                                                                         in these enzymes. B. szlbtilis QB5072 carries a point
                                                                                                                                                         mutation in the levE gene (G to A) producing the codon
                                                                                                                                                         change Trp-22 to stop-22. The impaired EIILeVis unable
                                                                                                                                                         to transport fructose, but the expression of the operon
                                                                                                                                                         becomes constitutive. Also in this strain, the levanase
                                                                                                                                                         gene ( s a d ) has been fused to the lac2 gene of E. coli to
                                                                                                                                                         facilitate the study of the regulation of this operon.
                                                                                                                                                         In order to determine if EIIBManfrom L. czirvatzls could
                                                                                                                                                         have a similar regulatory function to the LevE protein of
                                                                                                                                                         B. szlbtilis, mutant B. szibtilis QB5072 was transformed with
                                                                                                                                                         pM J 18 and pGAL9. When /I-galactosidase activity of
                                                                                                                                                         these transformants was assayed on LB plates containing
                                                                                                                                                         erythromycin and X-Gal, strains carrying pGAL9 gave
                                                                                                                                                         dark-blue colonies due to the constitutive expression of
                                                                                                                                                         the fused operon, while colonies bearing pM J 18 remained
                                                                                                                                                         white. In order to quantify this activity, both strains were
                                                                                                                                                         grown on basal medium with glycerol or fructose as

                                                                                                                                                         This experiment shows that the constitutive expression of
